title: Implement GHCR publication and recovery workflows
description:
The exact attested OCI candidate is assigned the immutable v1 tag under serialized, digest-preserving publication and recovery.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The GHCR workflow authenticates final-tag and npm completion plus escrow identities, enters the constant publication mutex, verifies absent or exact matching live state, and publishes with digest-preserving Skopeo from the retained OCI archive.
- [hard] REQ-02: D_index, D_run, descriptors, subjects, pull/runtime smoke, and tag readback match escrow before completion; recovery uses tag, escrow, and live registry state without rebuild or tag movement.
- [hard] REQ-03: Fixtures reject digest/subject change, conflicting tags, non-escrow bytes, mutation outside the mutex, unsafe retry, or broader-than-required packages authority.

## Notes

Blast radius: GHCR publication/recovery workflow YAML and registry fixtures only.
